# Gradient Resolutions

> San Diego practice of Laura Lorber, J.D., an MC3 Certified Mediator and Parenting Coordinator. Family mediation, parenting coordination, and facilitation for organizations.

## Families
- [Family mediation and co-parenting](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/family.html): Mediation and co-parenting support for separating and co-parenting families.
- [Parenting coordination](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/pc.html): Ongoing parenting coordination for high-conflict co-parenting cases.
- [Babies and toddlers](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/babies.html): Coaching and mediation for families with children three and under.
- [Courses and workbook](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/courses.html): Self-paced co-parenting course and workbook.

## Professionals
- [Attorneys and mediators](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/attorneys.html): Referral information for attorneys and mediators.
- [Packages](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/packages.html): Service packages and pricing.

## Organizations
- [Retreat and convening facilitation](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/retreats.html): Facilitation for board retreats, staff planning sessions, and convenings. Half-day and full-day rates, a sliding scale by organization budget, and a free 30-minute call. Separate from the family practice.

## About
- [About Laura Lorber](https://www.gradientresolutions.com/about.html): Background, credentials, and approach.
